escrow.heading: Payment protection (escrow)
escrow.intro: Pay into escrow and our RBI-authorised payment partner holds the money until you accept delivery. If something goes wrong, you can open a dispute before the money is released.
escrow.optionalNote: Escrow is optional. You can also settle directly with the seller.
escrow.nudge: You have not completed an order with this seller before, so we strongly recommend paying through escrow.
escrow.feeDisclosure: You pay only the order total of {amount}. The seller pays the escrow fee ({percent}% plus GST, capped at {cap}); it is never added to your bill.
escrow.fundedNote: Your payment is held safely by our payment partner. The seller cannot access it yet.
escrow.autoRelease: The money is released to the seller automatically on {date} unless you accept earlier or raise a dispute.
escrow.frozen: A dispute is open. The money is frozen and will not be released until the dispute is resolved.
escrow.payMockHelp: Test checkout only. No real money moves.
escrow.acceptHelp: Accept only after you have received the goods as agreed. This releases the money to the seller.
escrow.acceptWaiting: You can accept delivery once the seller marks the order as dispatched.
escrow.releasedNote: The payment has been released to the seller.
escrow.refundedNote: The payment has been refunded to you.
escrow.cancelledNote: This escrow was closed without any payment.
escrow.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
